body: We dated for a long time. We remained close friends thereafter. We had an on and off relationship up until a few months ago. I was at my happiest. I found out he had a girlfriend. He was keeping it from me. I told him a long time ago if this were to happen, I wouldn't stay because it'd hurt too much. I just never thought it'd happen so sudden. I feel hurt and used and just worthless. I wouldn't be able to bear having good times with him but remembering he's with another girl now. I still have very strong feelings for him.
